notation.M: per-point sum of |contribution| entering a pressure (fit/*__png_magnitude, *__prg_magnitude)
notation.p_exact: pressure from correctly rounded (math.fsum) sums of the reference terms

exact_equality: observation point ids, row order, use/selection flags, selection reasons, saturation flags
facet order and geometry identities (elements.bin, BDF, gravity cache definition)
late_ng_not_rg and every NG/RG visibility mask (bitwise)
cliff masks after threshold-band facets are resolved by the CPU reference
parameter names, order, bounds, x_scale, optimizer settings
regularization rows and Gram/Cholesky factors (computed by the shared CPU code)

pressure_vs_cpu_reference.rationale: CPU sequential bincount error (measured <= 216 eps M) plus GPU fixed-order reduction (<= 64 eps M), with ~1.8x margin; RG cancellation ratio M/|p| measured 1.0

log_residual_vs_cpu_reference.note: r_i = w_g (ln p_i - ln p_obs_i), w_g = 1/sqrt(N_g); pressure floor applied identically

jacobian_vs_cpu_reference.provisional: signed basis columns can cancel; C06 replaces this with an eps*magnitude bound once per-entry magnitudes are computed
jacobian_vs_cpu_reference.decision_point: end of C06: replace by an eps*magnitude bound from per-entry magnitudes

proposed_replacement.abs_le: 1024 * eps * M_J[i, j] per entry; entries with M_J == 0 exactly 0 on both sides
proposed_replacement.magnitude: M_J[i, j] = sum of |contribution| entering entry (i, j), reference per-contribution terms (tools/c06_jacobian_budget.py)
proposed_replacement.evidence: cops_output/cuda_c06/jacobian_budget_20261019T223008Z/report.json: max 329 eps M_J (C00b 47-point and 23-point full-run verification subsets, B29/N30/C30/NC31/R30, all fixture states)

jacobian_vs_central_difference.note: sanity only: reference analytic vs central difference agrees to <= 6.1e-6 on non-branch-crossing columns at h = 1e-6 max(1,|x|); branch-crossing columns are excluded, never tolerated by loosening

cpp_replay.note: existing replay gate; measured 9.1e-10 on the subset; necessary but not sufficient

objective_vs_cpu_reference.reason: a fixed relative bound fails a correct evaluator when residuals are small (rms 0.05 gives ~4e-12)
objective_vs_cpu_reference.regularization_term: computed by the shared CPU code from the same x: contributes zero

acceleration_vs_package.applies_to: every target where the package result is finite
acceleration_vs_package.also_applies_to: 788k campaign targets: facets at 0.1 m / 0.05 m offset and on-surface centroids

threshold_band_deg.rule: facets with |slope - threshold| <= band are recomputed with the CPU reference and take its classification

gravity_fp64.nonfinite_reference_points: GPU NaN pattern must equal the package's; NaN points are reported and excluded, never repaired
gravity_fp64.term_magnitude: M = G*rho * sum_faces[ sum_q |sigma_pq h_pq LN_pq| + h_p sum_q |sigma_pq| (|atan t0_q| + |atan t1_q|) + |sing_A| ], accumulated by kernels/gravity.cu
gravity_fp64.amendment_reason: relative-to-|g| budgets are meaningless under cancellation (far field, symmetric centres): measured rel error up to 4e-10 at 50 R while |dg|/M <= 0.33 eps

repeatability.same_configuration: bitwise identical results for a pinned device model, launch configuration, CuPy and NVRTC version
repeatability.cross_configuration: measured and reported; must satisfy the budgets above

end_to_end_fit_fp64_provisional.termination: same status class (converged by ftol/xtol/gtol) or both at max_nfev
end_to_end_fit_fp64_provisional.parameters: within 1e-3 Gauss-Newton posterior sigma; along null/near-null directions predictions within 1e-8 relative instead
end_to_end_fit_fp64_provisional.note: TRF amplifies 1e-13 evaluator differences along a trajectory; refine after the first C06/C07 equivalence run
end_to_end_fit_fp64_provisional.decision_point: after the first full CPU-vs-GPU fit in C06/C07

mixed_precision: no budget exists; C08 must propose and justify one, subject to separate approval
